item.title: Saudi Aramco Dismisses Oil Glut Narrative As “Seriously Exaggerated”
item.description: Forecasts of a massive oil glut are seriously exaggerated as demand keeps rising and global stocks are below the five-year average, according to Saudi Aramco’s chief executive officer, Amin Nasser. “Oil glut predictions are seriously exaggerated,” Nasser said on the sidelines of the World Economic Forum in Davos, Switzerland, last week as carried by Reuters. item.title: Bahrain To Activate Smart Traffic Cameras From February 1, 2026
item.description: The Ministry of Interior announced that the General Directorate of Traffic will begin operating the first phase of the Smart Camera System starting February 1, 2026, following confirmation that the technical infrastructure is fully ready and capable of operating efficiently under various conditions. In a statement, the Ministry said that intensified public awareness campaigns will be rolled out in the coming days, focusing on the key traffic violations that can be detected by the smart cameras.

item.title: Bahrain: Starlink High-Speed Wi-Fi To Roll Out On Gulf Air Fleet
item.description: Bahrain’s national carrier, Gulf Air, has announced a historic partnership with SpaceX’s Starlink service to introduce high-speed Wi-Fi on its flights, offering passengers a futuristic flying experience. The installation process is set to begin this year, with the airline aiming to have the first aircraft online by mid-year. item.title: Emirates Dubai to Newcastle Flight Diverts to Edinburgh After Emergency Alert
item.description: An Emirates flight from Dubai to Newcastle was diverted to Edinburgh on January 27 after adverse weather conditions disrupted its approach into northern England, triggering an emergency alert and a delayed arrival for passengers. The Boeing 777-300ER, operating flight EK35, was due to land in Newcastle shortly after 11.20 am local time. item.title: Heavy Rain Sparks Dangerous Wadi Flows as Oman Urges Public to Stay Alert
item.description: Oman’s Civil Defence and Ambulance Authority (CDAA) has urged the public to exercise extreme caution and comply with official safety instructions as heavy rainfall continues to affect parts of the Sultanate, leading to active and potentially dangerous wadi flows. In a statement, the authority stressed that adherence to alerts and guidance issued through official channels is vital to protecting lives and property, underlining the importance of public cooperation during adverse weather conditions.

item.title: Nine Jailed for Seven Years in Gambling and Money Laundering Website Case in Kuwait
item.description: Kuwait’s Criminal Court has sentenced nine people to seven years in prison each and fined them KD1million after convicting them of forming an organised criminal gang that operated an online gambling website and laundered illicit funds. item.title: 75 Wildlife Species Released into King Abdulaziz Royal Reserve
item.description: The National Center for Wildlife (NCW), in cooperation with the King Abdulaziz Royal Reserve Development Authority, released 75 wildlife species into the King Abdulaziz Royal Reserve on Tuesday. With this release, the total number of wildlife species released by the NCW to date has exceeded 10,000 as part of its specialized programs.
